name: Brand Logos Scroller
author: aarambhsolutions

sections.description:
Brand Logos Scroller is a lightweight and responsive WordPress plugin that allows you to display brand, client, or partner logos in a smooth carousel using a simple shortcode.

Features

  • Infinite Scrolling: Smooth, continuous loop for logos or text.
  • Direction Control: Scroll left-to-right or right-to-left.
  • Media Library Integration: Easily select and manage logos from your WordPress Media Library.
  • Customizable Speed: Adjust the scrolling speed to your preference.
  • Responsive Design: Works perfectly on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.
  • Text Only Scroller: Option to create a text-based scrolling ticker.
  • Styling Options: Control borders, shadows, background colors, and more.
  • Shortcode Support: Place your scrollers anywhere using a simple shortcode.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the brands-logos-scroller folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘Brands Logos Scroller’ in the admin menu to create your first scroller.
  4. Use the provided shortcode [brands_logos_scroller id="XX"] in your posts or pages.
